notes: Behavioral evals focus on tool traces and Canvas state, not reply prose alone. Run against a fresh Codex task after plugin reinstall.

cases.prompt: Remake this 15-second product ad in high restoration for my new bottle. Keep the pacing and composition, replace only the product with the attached product image.
assertions: calls get_topview_canvas_generation_capabilities before planning task count
exactly one final video submit when capability max is 15s
final video inputs include product and AI keyframe typed sources
original reference video is not used as final reference_video input
no user continue/OK barrier between stages
refresh polls the same nodeId+taskId to terminal success

cases.prompt: Replicate this 16-second reference video in light restoration for a new summer drink story.
assertions: uses the fewest legal video tasks for 16s
prefers balanced 8+8 over 15+1 when max is 15
no short tail under capability min
anchor-first keyframes before final videos

cases.prompt: Make a 15-second 9:16 TikTok with hook, body, and CTA about my wireless earbuds. Generate a master visual and supporting keyframes first.
assertions: exactly one video task for 15s
master visual then derived keyframes
final video uses the full keyframe set as typed inputs
does not create Scene surrogates merely because there are three beats

cases.prompt: Create a 15-second product video in one bathroom scene for this serum bottle. Same product context throughout.
assertions: one Scene surrogate and one video task
primary and derived keyframes include original product typed input
final video includes keyframes and original product typed inputs
no default Character/Environment/Object cards

cases.prompt: Make a 15-second continuous short film of a courier biking through one rainy city street with multiple camera moves but no location jump.
assertions: one Scene / one video task despite multiple beats
character/environment assets used as typed canvas_asset inputs
style brief is not a default visual input

cases.prompt: Make a 45-second short film that hard-cuts from a desert noon interrogation to a neon midnight rooftop confession with the same heroine speaking in both places.
assertions: allows split across capability max
each segment repeats that segment's asset typed inputs
voice continuity waits for durable audio before the second speaking video

cases.prompt: Edit this 22-second source video: replace the man in the red jacket with my attached character and keep all shots, timing, and actions frame-aligned.
assertions: reads exact durationMs before segmentation
balanced segment count with no short tail
each segment submit includes reference_video
does not claim completion via start/end-only regeneration

cases.prompt: Create two back-to-back 8-second clips of the same heroine explaining a plan. Keep her speaking voice consistent across both clips.
assertions: first speaking video reaches success before voice extract/bind
second video waits for durable audio ref
second submit includes typed reference_audio and matching mention

cases.prompt: Generate a 24-second continuous product demo video. Use whatever live model is available, but respect its real max duration.
assertions: plans from live capability max, not a hardcoded 15
if mocked max=10, segments follow 10-second math with no short tail

cases.prompt: Frame-align edit this source video to replace the background, but assume video_edit/reference_video is unavailable in capabilities.
assertions: returns partial or blocked
does not silent-downgrade to text_to_video and claim frame-aligned success

cases.prompt: Update my Canvas Timeline draft and export it; another client may have changed the Timeline ETag meanwhile.
assertions: uses expectedTimelineEtag from get_topview_canvas_timeline
on Timeline REVISION_CONFLICT re-reads timeline and reapplies intent
does not recover Canvas node writes via expectedRevision
does not create duplicate generation cards for one intent

cases.prompt: Generate a short video; if capabilityVersion expired mid-flight, recover correctly.
assertions: re-fetches capabilities
re-validates stage plan before resubmit

cases.prompt: Create a character asset and immediately use it in a video once it is ready.
assertions: waits on pending_projection
does not invent shortCode or repeat the create write

cases.prompt: I extracted frames locally for replication; use them as keyframe references.
assertions: runs upload credential → PUT → check before submit
does not submit paid tasks with local paths or temp URLs

cases.prompt: After the social video segments succeed, put them on the Timeline and export a final MP4 without watermark if allowed.
assertions: updates full Timeline draft with ETag
only success durable media enters Timeline
reports complete only after export polling succeeds

cases.prompt: Generate directly with this exact prompt unchanged: A glossy red sneaker spins slowly on a white infinity cove, cinematic lighting, 10 seconds.
assertions: uses Direct fast path
preserves user prompt text
one video task at about 10 seconds
no continue barrier

cases.prompt: Research three public pages about reusable steel bottles and import only durable product images before any generation.
assertions: facts include source URLs
no fabricated URLs
imports become durable Canvas sources before any submit
imports via durable Canvas sources or upload bridge; no non-MCP import resume callbacks

cases.prompt: Create two scene nodes and generate storyboards in parallel where safe.
assertions: follows Safe Parallel Policy with distinct commandId and wait-all
does not send expectedRevision on create/submit/refresh
uses slim refresh omit or include=[]
uses projected get_topview_canvas_state fields/nodeIds/types when geometry is needed

cases.prompt: Create an image of a ceramic perfume bottle on a black stone pedestal. I did not choose a Canvas, model, resolution, or quality.
assertions: resolves or creates a Canvas and opens it before capability lookup or submit
uses Canvas-owned generation instead of topview_generate_image
selects the live capability marked preferred and submits its returned defaults without using client-side model or parameter constants
keeps the Canvas visible while polling so the user can participate

cases.prompt: Generate a ten-second video of sunlight moving across this room. Use the server defaults.
assertions: opens the target Canvas before capability lookup or submit
uses Canvas-owned generation instead of topview_generate_video
selects the live capability marked preferred and submits its returned defaults
an explicit user model or resolution overrides the server default when compatible

cases.prompt: Open a whiteboard, then help me build a 3D world and 3D director stage while I edit along with you.
assertions: resolves or creates and visibly opens one Canvas before any creative-surface action
keeps the Canvas visible for direct user participation
uses the interactive whiteboard/world_3d/director_stage UI path
does not substitute standalone image, video, or music generation when a base-surface MCP create action is unavailable
